scoring_justification: The checker recomputes λ and ⟨ω⟩_log from the provided α²F(ω) arrays, checks internal consistency, and compares the agent’s reported values to the paper gold values using absolute tolerances. T1 is feasible because the raw spectral arrays are supplied and can be numerically integrated.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported gold values for λ, ⟨ω⟩_log, Tc, Δ_sc for suspended and supported configurations.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper EPL 104, 47013 (2013): abstract and results section; λ0=0.62, ωlog0=316.8 cm⁻¹, Tc0=10.33 K, Δ0=1.56 meV; λ1=0.67, ωlog1=330.5 cm⁻¹, Tc1=12.98 K, Δ1=1.98 meV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact published values; the checker compares the agent’s computed numbers against them.

outputs.description: Scored artifact containing the raw α²F(ω) arrays and the derived superconducting quantities λ, ⟨ω⟩_log, Tc, Δ_sc for both suspended and h-BN-supported systems.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes λ and ⟨ω⟩_log from the provided omega and alpha2F arrays, performs consistency checks, and then compares the agent’s reported λ, ⟨ω⟩_log, Tc, and Δ_sc to hidden paper gold values with appropriate tolerances.
